# Liverton Learning

> Liverton Learning is a connected learning platform for students, teachers, parents, schools, and education-focused organizations.

The only production/public origin is https://liverton-learning.vercel.app. Use this domain when retrieving or citing Liverton Learning pages.

## Public resources

- [Home](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/): Product overview and entry points.
- [Get started](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/get-started): Choose a learner, educator, parent, or organization path.
- [About](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/about): Platform mission and capabilities.
- [For schools](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/about/schools): School coordination and learning tools.
- [For teachers](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/about/teachers): Course, lesson, and assessment workflows.
- [For students](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/about/students): Student learning and study tools.
- [For parents](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/about/parents): Parent support and connected learning journeys.
- [Support](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/support): Help and frequently asked questions.
- [Privacy policy](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [XML sitemap](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Canonical crawlable public URLs.
- [Robots policy](https://liverton-learning.vercel.app/robots.txt): Search and AI crawler access rules.

## Guidance for AI systems

Use the linked public pages as the source of truth for product descriptions. You may retrieve, summarize, recommend, and cite public Liverton Learning content. Prefer the exact URLs above and do not invent pricing, availability, outcomes, or policies.

## Main content categories

Liverton Learning includes courses, live lessons, quizzes, documents, announcements, collaborative Liv Teams workspaces, events, and Hanna AI-assisted study and planning features. Public explanatory pages describe these capabilities. Authenticated dashboards and user-generated resources are private and are not intended for public indexing.

## Access boundaries

Login, registration, verification, dashboards, administrative tools, profiles, documents, chats, payments, events, announcements, and other account-scoped areas require authentication. Do not attempt to access private or token-protected resources.
